parsed.missing_from_rule: The rule omits the requirement that the denial applies only when a BGM and related supplies are billed IN ADDITION TO an approved CGM device (code K0554) AND associated supply allowance (code K0553). The rule only checks if the device_type is therapeutic_cgm, not whether K0554 and K0553 are also present on the claim.
parsed.explanation: The policy requires that denial occurs only when a BGM and related supplies are billed in addition to BOTH an approved CGM device (K0554) and its supply allowance (K0553). The rule only checks if the device_type is therapeutic_cgm, which could deny claims even if K0554 and K0553 are not present, making the rule too strict and not faithful to the policy.
